subject.title: feat(hooks): add ACP turn transcript save hook

question: Should OpenClaw core sponsor `agent:turn:transcript:save` as a maintained ACP transcript-durability hook contract?
rationale: The implementation is plausible, but accepting it means committing to a new core hook/API surface and save-ordering semantics that automation should not decide without maintainer intent.

options.title: Close unsponsored surface
options.body: Close this PR for now and invite a maintainer-sponsored replacement if the hook contract is accepted later.

options.title: Sponsor this hook contract
options.body: Keep or reopen the PR only if a maintainer explicitly accepts the event name, payload, ordering, and compatibility expectations, then require a rebase and fresh proof.

options.title: Fold into lifecycle-hook design
options.body: Track transcript-save durability under the broader lifecycle-hook discussion instead of landing this split event independently.

recommendation.title: Close unsponsored surface
recommendation.body: Close this PR for now and invite a maintainer-sponsored replacement if the hook contract is accepted later.
